title: Power Monitor
description: Reads the voltage and the current of one channel of a power monitor device (for example an INA3221) into two variables.
activation: Runs every pass while enabled; to read at a fixed rate, put a Periodic block's tick on Run when.

voltage.title: Voltage
voltage.description: Bus voltage of the channel, in volts.

current.title: Current
current.description: Current of the channel, in amperes (negative when it flows backwards).

eno.title: Read
eno.description: True when every connected output was read and written this pass.
